name: Ogata Shinobu
source:
“Well, you’re just a dull cherry boy, but your Shinobu onee-sama is willing to make you a man, so you better be grateful, alright?”

The poster girl of the liquor shop Ogata in the West Urehashi shopping district. Has an efficient personality and hates indecisive men. She left for the city to study, and eventually found employment. A year ago, she returned to her hometown to help her family business.

Among the aging population of the shopping district, she is second only to [url=https://vndb.org/c57566]Tsukasa[/url] in terms of youth. Since their childhood, she treats her childhood friend Tsukasa like her own servant, however, as she has no ill intent, they simply look like adolescent siblings. With the intent of shaping Tsukasa up, she lets him work part time at their liquor shop, which led to the growth of their intimacy.  

Her beauty and exceptional figure stands out when she shuts up, and was apparently popular with the men back in the city. Unlike in their childhood days, both of their mind and body has grown, and thus the sibling-like relationship they had started to feel awkward.

[Translated from [url=http://cattleyasoft.com/cat06/character.html]Official Site[/url]]
